name: Kinokuniya Hall
address: Tokyo 160-0022 Kinokuniya Bookstore Shinjuku Main Store 4F, 3-17-7 Shinjuku, Shinjuku-ku
accessSummary: Shinjuku Station East Exit (JR lines, Odakyu Line, Keio Line): 5 min walk / Shinjuku-sanchome Station (Tokyo Metro Marunouchi Line / Fukutoshin Line, Toei Shinjuku Line) Exit B7
hours: The usage slots are morning 9:00-12:00 / afternoon 13:00-16:30 / evening 17:30-21:30 / all day 9:00-21:30, and include setup and cleanup time. Extensions are allowed only if the theater has agreed in advance, with a surcharge of 30% of the theater fee for every 30 minutes over (usage fee table, from January 1, 2023).

rooms.name: Kinokuniya Hall
rooms.note: 427 fixed seats (the seating chart says "Seats: 427"). The seats numbered 1 and 2 and 19 and 20 in rows I and J are removable and can also be used as wheelchair spaces. The stage plan gives "opening width 9.0 m, depth 6.6-7.1 m, height 6.1 m". Usage fees (excluding tax, from January 1, 2023) are, on weekdays, morning 107,000 yen / afternoon 158,000 yen / evening 201,000 yen / all day 431,000 yen, and on Sat, Sun & holidays, morning 147,000 yen / afternoon 209,000 yen / evening 209,000 yen / all day 491,000 yen (consecutive slots: weekdays morning + afternoon 251,000 yen and afternoon + evening 332,000 yen; Sat, Sun & holidays morning + afternoon 333,000 yen and afternoon + evening 408,000 yen).

ops.waitingRooms: The dressing room is the size of 20 tatami mats, with 22 dressing-room mirrors and 1 full-length mirror, and has a shower room and a washroom (equipment fee list, from August 2024). Equipment around the dressing room includes folding chairs, long tables, a refrigerator (2-door, with freezer), a microwave (1500 W), a washing machine (twin-tub), an electric kettle (4 L), a full-length mirror and Ständer (シュテンダー) (production-side equipment list for the hall).
